title: Oven Roasted Thai Berry Crumble
description: A roasted and tender Thai dish featuring frozen mixed berries and a soffritto-base, perfect for a crowd, and plant-based-friendly.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, mix together the thawed mixed berries, chopped onion, minced garlic, and grated ginger.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the lemon juice and maple syrup, then pour the mixture over the berry mixture and stir until combined.
In another bowl, mix together the oats, almond flour, and coconut oil until crumbly.
Transfer the berry mixture to a 9x9 inch baking dish and top with the oat mixture.
Bake for 35-40 minutes, or until the topping is golden brown and the fruit is tender.
Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
Serve warm, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
